description: The CodeBoarding-action system operates as a linear pipeline within a GitHub Action environment, transforming raw source code changes into visual architectural insights through orchestration, structural diffing, visualization, and integration layers.

components.name: Analysis Orchestrator
components.description: Acts as the central controller for the action. It validates the environment, manages the transition between full codebase scans and incremental PR analysis, and ensures metadata consistency across runs.

components.name: Execution Controller
components.description: Manages the high-level lifecycle of the action, including environment validation, state persistence, and the decision logic for running full codebase scans versus incremental PR analysis.

components.name: Component Mapper
components.description: Bridges the gap between raw file system changes and the logical architecture by aggregating file-level diffs into component-level changes.

components.name: Visual Synthesis Engine
components.description: Responsible for the deterministic generation of Mermaid.js diagrams, processing mapped component changes to produce hierarchical visualizations.

components_relations.relation: provides mapped component diffs for rendering
validates change status for visual inclusion

components.name: Structural Diffing Engine
components.description: Analyzes the codebase to identify structural modifications. It maps file-level changes to architectural components and extracts method-level differences to determine the scope of the impact.

components.name: Structural Change Analyzer
components.description: Responsible for the low-level inspection of code changes, distinguishing between trivial textual edits and structural modifications to determine the actual impact on the codebase.

components.name: Incremental Analysis Orchestrator
components.description: Manages the execution lifecycle and state of the engine by comparing current changes against stored metadata to decide between full scans or incremental updates.

components.name: Analysis Validator & Feedback Loop
components.description: Ensures the integrity of the diffing process by monitoring analysis health, validating structural mapping accuracy, and processing external feedback.

components.name: Mermaid Visualization Engine
components.description: Translates the structural diff data into Mermaid.js syntax. It handles the recursive rendering of nested components, applies status indicators (added/modified/deleted), and filters noise to ensure diagram readability.

components.name: Structural Diff Engine
components.description: Responsible for loading the analysis.json artifacts and performing a deep comparison between the 'before' and 'after' states.

components.name: Recursive Mermaid Translator
components.description: The core rendering logic that translates the structural diff into Mermaid.js syntax using a recursive visitor pattern.

components.name: Architectural Context Resolver
components.description: Maps physical file changes to logical architectural components to provide change context.

components.name: UI & Integration Orchestrator
components.description: Wraps generated Mermaid diagrams with metadata and integrates health reports for GitHub output.

components_relations.relation: provides structural diff data for rendering
maps file-level changes to architectural methods
provides generated Mermaid syntax for UI wrapping
supplies change metadata for health reports

components.name: UX & Integration Layer
components.description: Manages the final presentation of data to the user, including GitHub comments, feedback loops, and external integrations. It handles telemetry and user feedback via PostHog, closing the feedback loop between the user and the tool. Key class/method: scripts.submit_feedback.py.

components.name: Telemetry & Feedback Handler
components.description: Manages the collection and submission of telemetry data and user feedback to external endpoints. Includes logic from scripts.submit_feedback.

components.name: Presentation Orchestrator & State Manager
components.description: Acts as the primary coordinator for the UX layer, validating analysis state, managing quotas, and ensuring data consistency for visualizers and CTA builders.

components.name: Visual Diagramming Engine
components.description: Translates internal diff data and component relationships into Mermaid.js syntax, managing scope and label truncation for GitHub UI readability.

components.name: IDE & Web Integration Handler
components.description: Detects user environments and generates specialized URLs to enable direct navigation from GitHub comments to local IDEs or webviews.

components_relations.relation: provides analysis state for CTA generation
requests visual context for feedback reports
Passes metadata about the analysis to be included in telemetry payloads
provides filtered change sets for diagramming
